description_en: Retrieves a list of users who have read the changed files in a merge request
description_zh: 查询合并请求变更文件的已读情况，主要获取变更文件的已读人列表
name: ListMergeRequestFilesReads

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. You can find this ID in your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[organizationId]`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you authenticate using an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK/SK) or temporary credentials from the Security Token Service (STS)
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The sequential ID of the merge request within the repository
parameters.help_zh: 合并请求局部ID，表示代码库下的第几个合并请求
parameters.name: local_id

parameters.help_en:
The business ID of the patch set for the target branch.

> In APIs for merge requests and comparisons, the `from` and `to` parameters can be counter-intuitive: `from` is the target branch and `to` is the source branch. This order matches the Git execution sequence. The UI reverses these terms for clarity
parameters.help_zh:
合并目标的版本业务ID

> 关于from和to，在合并请求以及比较相关的接口中，from和to与常识是相反的，即 from应该是合并目标，to才是合并源，该顺序符合实际Git执行时的顺序，页面UI的源和目标实际上是经过处理后的，才会符合直觉
parameters.name: from_patch_set_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The business ID of the patch set for the source branch.

> In APIs for merge requests and comparisons, the `from` and `to` parameters can be counter-intuitive: `from` is the target branch and `to` is the source branch. This order matches the Git execution sequence. The UI reverses these terms for clarity
parameters.help_zh:
合并源的版本业务ID

> 关于from和to，在合并请求以及比较相关的接口中，from和to与常识是相反的，即 from应该是合并目标，to才是合并源，该顺序符合实际Git执行时的顺序，页面UI的源和目标实际上是经过处理后的，才会符合直觉
parameters.name: to_patch_set_biz_id
